SELECT c.compliancetrace AS record_id, c.gdprcomp AS gdpr_compliance_status, c.loclawcomp AS local_law_compliance_status, d.orignation || ' -> ' || d.destnation AS transfer_path
FROM compliance AS c
JOIN riskmanagement AS r ON c.risktie = r.risktrace
JOIN dataflow AS d ON r.flowlink = d.recordregistry
WHERE (c.gdprcomp = 'Non-compliant' OR c.loclawcomp = 'Non-compliant')
  AND d.orignation <> d.destnation
ORDER BY c.compliancetrace ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.compliancetrace AS record_id, c.gdprcomp AS gdpr_compliance_status, c.loclawcomp AS local_law_compliance_status, d.orignation || ' -> ' || d.destnation AS transfer_path
FROM compliance AS c
JOIN riskmanagement AS r ON c.risktie = r.risktrace
JOIN dataflow AS d ON r.flowlink = d.recordregistry
WHERE (c.gdprcomp = 'Non-compliant' OR c.loclawcomp = 'Non-compliant')
  AND d.orignation <> d.destnation
ORDER BY c.compliancetrace ASC
LIMIT 10;
